article.title: Why a Customer’s First Purchase Does Not Always Mean Acquisition
article.why: Practical analytical English for data-driven decisions.

paragraphs.en: A customer’s first purchase in a dataset is not always the day the customer was truly acquired. If reliable history begins in January, a person who first appears in March may have purchased before the observation window. The data shows a first observed purchase, not necessarily a first-ever purchase. Customer IDs create the same problem. A person may receive a new ID after changing a card, account, app, or membership program. If old and new IDs are not linked, an existing customer can look new. Channel expansion also matters. Someone who has shopped in stores for years may make a first app purchase this month. That is a new-channel event, not automatically a new-customer event. Analysts should therefore define acquisition carefully. One definition may be no purchase during the previous twelve months. Another may require a confirmed membership start date. A third may focus on the first purchase in a specific business or channel. None is always correct; the right definition depends on the question. When history is incomplete, use precise language such as first observed purchase in the available period. This prevents a strong claim that the data cannot support and helps marketing teams avoid overstating new-customer growth. The key lesson is that first in the table and first in the customer’s real relationship are different ideas. Analysts should document the population, observation window, assumptions, and operational definition before drawing a business conclusion. A useful review separates the observed metric, the possible mechanism, and the action that follows from the evidence. This makes the analysis easier to reproduce, challenge, and communicate to stakeholders. paragraphs.zh: 繁中完整解說：本文逐步區分觀察到的數據、可能的商業機制與可支持的結論，避免把相關性、資料邊界或模型輸出直接當成因果事實。核心實務原則是先定義母體、期間與決策目的，再選擇合適的指標、實驗設計或解釋方式，最後把證據強度與下一步行動清楚連結。
paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳：本文は、観測されたデータ、考えられるbusiness mechanism、証拠から支持できる結論を分けて考える。相関、データ範囲、model outputをそのまま因果事実として扱わず、対象母集団・期間・意思決定目的を先に定義する。そのうえで適切な指標、実験設計、説明方法を選び、証拠の強さと次のactionを明確につなげることが実務上の要点である。
